name: NOAA ACSPO L3S-LEO near-real-time daily SST

rights.license: GHRSST protocol describes data use as free and open

temporal.update_cadence: Advertised daily, 12:00:00Z reference time; product page publishes 24-hour NRT latency and best-effort access. Actual provider-axis delivery latency is unmeasured. Last admitted check returned HTTP 404 HTML for all four requested variants, not time-axis CSV.

evidence.supports: Live product page, 2026-10-20. NRT ERDDAP lists KDaily as Kelvin and CDaily as degrees Celsius. Published latency details: 24 hours. Grid 0.02 degree. Sample names are PM/AM day and night files plus a Daily file. No 3-day product.

Live NOAA AOML CoastWatch DAS, history 2026-10-20T18:28:26Z. Same dataset id, local files. License string, quality_level 0-5, fill -327.68 degree_C, 0.02 degree WGS84 grid. time_coverage_end 2026-10-14T12:00:00Z. This copy lags the granule catalog.

Live NASA CMR read 2026-10-20T18:30:37Z of the collection named in the DAS metadata_link. Three Daily granules, reference times 2026-10-17, 2026-10-18 and 2026-10-19 at 12:00:00Z. Newest catalogued 2026-10-20T03:56:59Z.
Live STAR variable list. quality_level 5 is clear-sky and recommended for operational use. Front indicator is 1 or 0 in the valid clear-sky domain.

limitations: Owner decision on task t_7eaa1d53, 2026-10-23: adopt-with-limits for an observed layer with stated coverage gaps and cloud masking. Bulk downloads remain held. This does not clear rights or authorize live activation; offline implementation may proceed within those limits.
The license string is not a public-rights enum value, so the sources-entry proposal stays candidate and is not inserted into catalog/sources.json. Redistribution review remains false.
Clouds are missing pixels (fill -327.68 degree_C). Keep only quality_level 5. Do not fill gaps.

No provider 3-day composite: an application-derived mean of valid quality_level 5 SST over three consecutive CDaily reference days ending on the newest day, with missing days left missing. Retain per-cell contributing count and oldest/newest reference times; cells with no valid input stay empty. Never substitute older days or an analysis field.
KDaily is the Kelvin form of the same Daily line, labeled as such on the product page. Do not ingest noaacwLEOACSPOSSTL3SnrtKDaily as well as CDaily.
PM day and night files are orbit slices, not the 1-day or 3-day view. Their ERDDAP time axis was not measured live.

Published latency is 24 hours; historical catalog insertion lag is not delivery latency. Three actual provider-axis dates per variant remain not demonstrated. Last check 2026-10-23T13:52:42-45Z returned HTTP 404 HTML for CDaily, PMDay, PMNight and KDaily. Do not retry without fresh bounded admission or substitute catalog/inferred timestamps.

Proposed application age policy: withhold after 72 hours from the newest grid reference time, never from fetch/catalog time; withhold missing/failed data. A derived 3-day view must disclose older contributing observations within its fixed window.
AOML's local copy ended 2026-10-14T12:00:00Z. NEFSC's remote copy of the same griddap ended 2026-03-15T12:00:00Z on a live read. Do not use either as the freshness source.
Coverage is the published global envelope against the 15 region boxes. No California cell was sampled.
